label: Grouped NVFP4 MoE GEMM
mechanism: routed-expert GEMMs computed directly on packed NVFP4 bytes, one grouped launch per matrix
hypothesis: post-exp-0002 the batched decode step is still MoE-bound, not attention-bound: moe_experts is 645.9 ms of the 918 ms step at B=8 (70%) because every hit expert still materializes 112 MB of bf16 weight and re-reads it in cuBLAS (~225 MB HBM round-trip per expert to serve 1-2 rows) plus ~11 eager launches per expert and a per-layer unique().tolist() sync; a grouped Triton GEMM that dequantizes packed bytes in-register (bit-equal LUT, all 256 patterns verified) and runs all (token,slot) pairs in one launch per matrix deletes the traffic AND the loop, multiplying decode and prefill throughput
predicted_delta: +80-135% timeboxed decode_heavy tok/s (9.4 -> 17-22; measured: step wall 918 -> 405 ms at B=8 rep. cache lengths = 19.8 tok/s aggregate, moe_experts 646 -> 130 ms, t_batched batched arm 8.12 -> 25.31 tok/s, ref arm 4.03 -> 7.26, prefill 4.52 -> 2.79 s at ~900 tok)
